responsibility: Implements the generic output-side machinery for emitting LTO sections. It manages section begin/end calls through lang_hooks, optional compression of outgoing bytes, writing raw buffers and streamed lto_output_stream blocks, and creation/destruction of simple summary sections used by IPA passes. It also owns writer-side declaration-state stack management and records per-function lto_out_decl_state objects so later decl streaming can emit the directory of global and function-local declaration streams.
